prompt:
Edit paint_mask_guide.png exactly following this brief. Input image roles: paint_mask_guide.png is the edit target and authoritative pixel layout/silhouette; design_reference.png is material/detail reference; icon_x8.png is colour reference only (ignore magenta background).

Keep all gaps/openings transparent and both empty cells transparent.

Solid uniformly red silhouettes, absolutely no internal detail, shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. This helmet has only metal so use only pure red throughout the lower five silhouettes.

Lower half must contain exactly FIVE CLEAN solid flat-red shapes with crisp boundaries matching the guide, surrounded by completely transparent empty space. Preserve the guide silhouettes exactly. Upper five painted views stay within their exact guide silhouettes as well. Canvas must be exactly 3:4.
